title: ProjectRoutingOverrides
description: Safe, constraints-only project-local overrides for .pi/routing.yaml. This schema deliberately excludes routes, models, capacity assignment, precedence, fallback, execution/worktree isolation, mutation policy, review categories, and completion requirements: those remain sole properties of routing/default-policy.yaml.

risk_overrides.description: Floors applied on top of a task's classification. Ordered fields raise the task's value to at least the given floor; safety booleans may only be set to true (OR-merged). Fields absent here can never weaken global routing.

path_floors.description: Path-triggered risk floors. Each rule applies its floors (same keys and raise-only values as risk_overrides) to a task whose files_or_areas match one of its globs before routing, and to the worker's real changed paths before integration. Globs are repository-relative POSIX patterns anchored at the root: * and ? match inside one segment, a whole ** segment matches zero or more segments. Character classes, braces, backslashes, a leading ! or /, empty, . or .. segments and ** inside a segment are rejected.

protected_areas.description: Free-text protected areas, shown to the orchestrating prompt as context only. No tool enforces them; use path_floors for enforced, path-triggered floors.
